content.title: Keegan Bradley
content.text: Shinnecock Hills Golf Club • Southampton, N.Y. • June 18 - 21, 2026 Sign InSign In U.S. Open Shinnecock Hills Golf Club • Southampton, N.Y. • June 18 - 21, 2026 Keegan BradleyUnited States of AmericaAGE39CUTS MADE (STARTS)7 (13)BEST FINISHT-4 (2014) Profile Road to Shinnecock Hills F-11: Those players who qualified for the season-ending 2025 Tour Championship Bio The nephew of U.S. Women's Open champion Pat Bradley and 2025 U.S. Ryder Cup captain won the 2011 PGA Championship in a playoff over Jason Dufner at the Atlanta Athletic Club. He is one of four golfers to win a major title in his debut, joining Ben Curtis, Francis Ouimet and Willie Park Sr. He owns 14 worldwide victories, his last coming in the 2025 Travelers Championship. He played his collegiate golf at St. John's University. He also was a competitive ski racer in Vermont before switching his allegiance to golf as a teenager. He won nine college events for the Red Storm before turning pro in 2008. He was a member of 2012 and 2014 United States Ryder Cup Teams (he cpatained the 2025 side at Bethpage Black), and 2013 and 2024 U.S. Presidents Cup Teams. This will be his 14th U.S. Open start.
